rows.note: Use this as the everyday all-purpose noun for a designated zone or area with a particular use or rule.

example.english: This is the smoking zone, so you can smoke here.
example.traditional: 呢個係吸煙區，所以你可以喺度食煙。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 kap1 jin1 keoi1 so2 ji5 nei5 ho2 ji5 hai2 dou6 sik6 jin1

rows.note: Use this for a geographical region or area rather than a specially designated zone.

example.english: This zone often gets snow in winter.
example.traditional: 呢個地區冬天成日落雪。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 dei6 keoi1 dung1 tin1 sing4 jat6 lok6 syut3

rows.note: Use this when the zone is restricted or off-limits, such as a danger zone or a prohibited area.

example.english: This is a restricted zone; unauthorized people may not enter.
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 hai6 gam3 keoi1 haan4 jan4 min5 zeon3

rows.note: Use this for the high-focus performance state meant by being in the zone, often with 入 or 進入.

example.english: Once I get in the zone, I write much faster.
example.traditional: 我一入到狀態，寫嘢就快好多。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 jap6 dou3 zong6 taai3 se2 je5 zau6 faai3 hou2 do1
